channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Georgia U. is seeking ‘Abrahamic studies’ scholar to teach ‘feminist,’ ‘queer perspectives’
item.description: One of Georgia's public universities is seeking a scholar for "Abrahamic studies" who can teach from "feminist and queer perspectives."

item.title: Video: UCSF staffer allegedly threatens to ‘hunt’ down and ‘kill’ conservative activist
item.description: A woman who is believed to be a UC San Francisco employee allegedly threatened to "hunt" down and "kill" conservative activist Beth Bourne who was protesting against gender surgeries for minors.

item.title: Anti-DEI medical group debunks study claiming black patients benefit from black doctors
item.description: Racial concordance study ‘scientifically unsound,' Do No Harm argues.

item.title: U. Florida art class scraps accommodations for ‘trans,’ ‘BIPOC’ students
item.description: The University of Florida recently removed a section from an art class syllabus that offered special accommodations for 'BIPOC,' 'queer and trans students.'

item.title: Student sues Albany Law over professor’s alleged ‘hostile’ comments toward conservatives
item.description: A conservative student at Albany Law School of Union University recently filed a lawsuit against the private school in New York, alleging racial and viewpoint discrimination by a black faculty member for, among other things, telling students that the Founding Fathers were “worse than Hitler.” The federal lawsuit, filed suit in the U.S. District Court […]

item.title: Anti-Israel protesters who seized U. Washington building, caused $1M in damage, face charges
item.description: Thirty-three protesters who took over a University of Washington engineering building in May 2025, causing roughly $1 million in damage, are finally facing trespassing charges.

item.title: What do American students studying abroad think of Europe?
item.description: The College Fix's Simon Olech reports on American students' views of Europe from his study abroad program in Austria.

item.title: Bangor U. debate society refuses to debate conservative Reform UK, prompting backlash
item.description: Reform UK, a successor of the Brexit party, touts immigration controls, tax cuts, and deregulation.

item.title: NJ college revises policy after it banned funds to Christian Club
item.description: Atlantic Cape Community College revised its club funding policy after facing legal pressure regarding discrimination against religious and political student groups.

item.title: Indiana bill targeting ‘low-earning degrees’ heads to governor’s desk
item.description: Degrees with median earnings below high school graduates could be cut An Indiana bill that would cut funding for “low-earning degrees” is now headed to Governor Mike Braun’s desk and, if signed, would take effect on July 1.
